entry_state: The acceptance chapter closes with provisional workload limits and separate engineering, accounting, forecast and human evidence. The portable operation appendix now supplies lookup details for meanings already taught.
exit_state: The portable packages preserve financial connections, immutable source versions and explicit partial coverage. The operation registry separates preparation, review, compilation and history construction; uncertainty evaluation has begun and continues on the next page.
findings: The corporate package distinguishes source-reference closure from admission of every source line and keeps the debt text frontend narrower than typed company construction.
Joined-company transactions publish both legal books atomically; narrow component migration preserves subsequent operations without promising general interoperability.
The real-source connection admits no issuer-history branches or probability law; complete report-token subqueries do not erase its overall partial status.
The registry refers back to the common envelope and the previously taught effects rather than claiming deployed endpoints.
